observations: body: the page begins with the head of chapter 47, set in a larger type and centred; the title is in one line. The line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 174.» (L1, beside the head) and «p. 175.» (L24) in the right margin. The count of the lines runs through the head: 5 stands beside the title.
body L11, L15: *afīǵiyūn* and *ferīǵiyūn* are set in italic, with an acute over the g; in *afīǵiyūn* the f is printed as a thin slanting stroke, without its hooks.
body L12: in «ἀπόγειον» the omicron with its acute is printed broken.
body L13-L14: the lower half of the table is printed «a 90° ad 180° et a 180° ad 360°», against the upper half «a 0° ad 90° vel a 270° ad 360°» of L10; kept as printed.
body L15: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic; with chapter 47 the letters begin again at a.
body L2, L4, L34: specks stand over the last e of «quinque» in the title, over the u of «Saturnum» and before «aut», and over the e of «etiam»; they are not signs.
notes_right L4: the 0 of «60°» is printed broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
